checks.original_bytes: Independent Thumb+MCLASS decoding confirms 46F8's fresh outer-field read, call to 9F9C, add-half-then-shift calculation, and restored frame. 9F9C independently rereads the inner field, dispatches selector 0 to 9C44, 1 to 9C38, otherwise zero, then applies its own rounded shift. Both exact executable spans exclude following pools/NOPs.
checks.replay_and_oracle: All 192 isolated original-byte combinations pass and regenerate candidate rows exactly. Independent arithmetic checks the modulo-u32 add-half rule over all four shift values at each stage; two ordered reads, selector calls, returned result, and SP are checked.

limits: The test holds the synthetic selector register constant across both fresh reads; simultaneous hardware changes are not tested.
Selector/source helpers are controlled, and physical frequency/register meaning is not proved.
